shared_elements: circular disc motif (chariot wheel; disc on torso)
justification: Both are stone monuments whose surfaces carry low-relief carving including anthropomorphic forms and a prominent circular disc, but that is where correspondence ends. A is a wide horizontal narrative frieze with finely modelled, densely overlapping animals, chariot and figures reading left to right, whereas B is a vertical, blocky, heavily eroded monolith with a few schematic, isolated motifs and no narrative sequence.
